semantic_contract: Log registration, allocate zte_touch with PLATFORM_DEVID_NONE and store it at tpd_cdev + 0xdd0.
On allocation failure clear the callback at tpd_cdev + 0xea0 and return -ENOMEM.
On negative platform_device_add return, invoke dev.release, clear the callback and return the original error.
On zero or positive platform_device_add return, normalize the function result to zero and install tpd_report_uevent at tpd_cdev + 0xea0.
